app.name: Projection
app.tagline: Private financial and retirement planning, running on your own machine.
lang.label: Language
home.feature.cashflow: Sankey diagrams of how money flows each year.
home.feature.finances: Record accounts, income, expenses and debts by hand, without linking banks.
home.feature.milestones: Milestones such as financial independence that start or stop income and expenses.
home.feature.plan: A month-by-month projection of your net worth to the end of your life.
home.feature.success: Monte Carlo simulations and tests against historical returns.
home.feature.taxes: Spanish taxes (IRPF), starting with a flat effective rate.
home.intro: Model your whole financial life: income, expenses, accounts, debts and milestones such as financial independence or retirement. Your data is stored only on this machine.
home.title: Welcome
demo.assumptions: Example starting with %s at a %s annual return, compounded monthly.
demo.chart_label: Chart of the balance year by year, split into contributions and growth.
demo.headline: What %s a month becomes in %d years
plan.assumptions_desc: What the plan assumes about the future. Each change is saved and the plan recalculates straight away.
plan.autosave: Changes are saved when you leave each field.
plan.chart.label: Chart of net worth over the plan, with each account's balance and debts.
plan.end_value_nominal: Net worth at the end of the plan, in %d euros.
plan.end_value_real: Net worth at the end of the plan, in today's euros.
plan.fail: With these assumptions, the money runs out in %s.
plan.intro: Your money month by month until the end of the plan, based on your current finances and the assumptions below.
plan.no_accounts: No accounts: add at least one in Current finances to hold what you save.
plan.no_people: To project your plan we need to know how long it lasts: add at least one person with their birth date.
plan.ok: With these assumptions, your money lasts until age %d.
plan.returns_desc: Used for accounts without a return of their own.
plan.saved: Saved. The plan has been recalculated.
plan.shortfall: %s short of covering expenses until age %d.
plan.table.desc_nominal: In each year's euros, not adjusted for inflation.
plan.table.desc_real: In today's euros: every amount is adjusted for expected inflation.
plan.title: Plan
finances.intro: Where you stand today: who the plan covers, what you own, earn, spend and owe. Type amounts however you like, for example 1,250.50.
finances.title: Current finances
summary.empty: Add your accounts, income, expenses and debts to see where you stand.
summary.label: Summary
summary.note: Before tax. Only counts income and expenses active this month; extra and yearly payments are spread over 12 months.
people.desc: Who the plan covers: you and, if you like, your partner. Birth date and life expectancy set how long the plan runs.
people.empty: Nobody yet. Start by adding yourself.
people.title: People
accounts.desc: What you own: current account, savings, investments, pension plans or the value of a home.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add your current account to start.
accounts.title: Accounts
incomes.desc: Money coming in: salary, self-employment, rent or pensions. Gross amounts, before tax.
incomes.empty: No income yet. Add your salary or another source of income.
incomes.title: Income
expenses.desc: Money going out each month or each year. Loan payments go under Debts.
expenses.empty: No expenses yet. Add rent, food or other regular expenses.
expenses.title: Expenses
debts.desc: What you owe: mortgage, loans or cards. From the balance, rate and payment we work out when you finish paying.
debts.empty: No debts. If you have a mortgage or a loan, add it here.
debts.never: The payment does not cover the interest
debts.title: Debts
field.name: Name
hint.amount_payment: What you receive or pay each time, not the monthly average.
hint.contribution: What you add to this account each month.
hint.debt_balance: What you still owe, without future interest.
hint.growth: Leave empty to rise with inflation.
hint.inflation: Raises income and expenses that follow inflation, and converts to today's euros.
hint.life_expectancy: The age you want the plan to reach.
hint.rate: The nominal rate in your contract.
hint.return: Leave empty to use the default return for this account type.
hint.surplus: What is left each month, after contributions.
hint.tax_rate: Average effective rate on gross income. Detailed Spanish income tax comes later.
form.error.end_before_start: The end date must be after the start date.
form.error.future: The date cannot be in the future.
form.error.max_people: A plan covers at most two people.
form.error.range: This value is outside the allowed range.
footer.privacy: Your data never leaves this machine.
